name: close-button
title: Close button
description: The icon-only button that closes a dialog, sheet, banner or panel, named "Close" in the current language.

when: Closing a surface that can be dismissed.

youProvide: A more specific `label` when several close buttons share a view.

CloseButton.name: suppressHydrationWarning
CloseButton.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).

CloseButton.name: autoFocus
CloseButton.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.

CloseButton.name: id
CloseButton.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).

CloseButton.name: slot
CloseButton.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

CloseButton.name: aria-controls
CloseButton.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

CloseButton.name: aria-current
CloseButton.description:
Indicates whether this element represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

CloseButton.name: aria-describedby
CloseButton.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

CloseButton.name: aria-details
CloseButton.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.

CloseButton.name: aria-disabled
CloseButton.description: Indicates whether the element is disabled to users of assistive technology.

CloseButton.name: aria-expanded
CloseButton.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

CloseButton.name: aria-haspopup
CloseButton.description:
Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that
can be triggered by an element.

CloseButton.name: aria-labelledby
CloseButton.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

CloseButton.name: aria-pressed
CloseButton.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

CloseButton.name: onFocus
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

CloseButton.name: onBlur
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

CloseButton.name: onKeyDown
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

CloseButton.name: onKeyUp
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

CloseButton.name: onClick
CloseButton.description:
**Not recommended – use `onPress` instead.** `onClick` is an alias for `onPress`
provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.

CloseButton.name: isDisabled
CloseButton.description: Whether the button is disabled.

CloseButton.name: onPress
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

CloseButton.name: onPressStart
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

CloseButton.name: onPressEnd
CloseButton.description:
Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either
over the target or when the pointer leaves the target.

CloseButton.name: onPressChange
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the press state changes.

CloseButton.name: onPressUp
CloseButton.description:
Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

CloseButton.name: onFocusChange
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

CloseButton.name: type
CloseButton.description: The behavior of the button when used in an HTML form.

CloseButton.name: preventFocusOnPress
CloseButton.description:
Whether to prevent focus from moving to the button when pressing it.

Caution, this can make the button inaccessible and should only be used when alternative
keyboard interaction is provided, such as ComboBox's MenuTrigger or a NumberField's
increment/decrement control.

CloseButton.name: form
CloseButton.description:
The `<form>` element to associate the button with.
The value of this attribute must be the id of a `<form>` in the same document.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/button#form).

CloseButton.name: formAction
CloseButton.description:
The URL that processes the information submitted by the button.
Overrides the action attribute of the button's form owner.

CloseButton.name: formEncType
CloseButton.description: Indicates how to encode the form data that is submitted.

CloseButton.name: formMethod
CloseButton.description: Indicates the HTTP method used to submit the form.

CloseButton.name: formNoValidate
CloseButton.description: Indicates that the form is not to be validated when it is submitted.

CloseButton.name: formTarget
CloseButton.description: Overrides the target attribute of the button's form owner.

CloseButton.name: name
CloseButton.description: Submitted as a pair with the button's value as part of the form data.

CloseButton.name: value
CloseButton.description: The value associated with the button's name when it's submitted with the form data.

CloseButton.name: excludeFromTabOrder
CloseButton.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.

CloseButton.name: isPending
CloseButton.description:
Whether the button is in a pending state. This disables press and hover events
while retaining focusability, and announces the pending state to screen readers.

CloseButton.name: onHoverStart
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction starts.

CloseButton.name: onHoverEnd
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction ends.

CloseButton.name: onHoverChange
CloseButton.description: Handler that is called when the hover state changes.

CloseButton.name: render
CloseButton.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

CloseButton.name: aria-label
CloseButton.description: Overrides the localized "Close" name.
